title: draba reptans var. micrantha
intro: Draba reptans var. micrantha, commonly known as Rockcress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Rockcress include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Rockcress include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
